## Submission Workflow (Two-Stage)

**1. Homework Solutions — due Tuesday 11:59 pm (Canvas)**

- Upload as **one single, readable PDF** (not a photo dump)
- Organize clearly. Show your work. Label final answers.
- **No late submissions:** Solutions are posted Wednesday morning.

**2. Grade Memo — due Friday 11:59 pm (Canvas)**

- Self-assess your work using the posted solutions and rubric
- Include: what you got right, what broke, what you learned, what you'll do differently
- Per-problem self-rating (1–5) with brief justification
- AI and collaboration disclosure (even if "none")

**Exception:** A final synthesis-style homework assigned immediately before the cumulative final may not include a separate grade memo.

**Lowest homework score is dropped** (to cover one off-week or emergency).

See the [syllabus](../course-info/syllabus.qmd#sec-homework) for the full rubric and grading details.
